role: Domain router for change, PR, security, architecture, verification, codebase-planning, and adversarial-claim review modes.
notes: Ship calls /1-code-review directly. Honor an already-selected review mode; use F-R1 only for ambiguity. Pin the actual candidate, including task-owned dirty work when requested; all child reviews return read-only evidence to their caller.

children.note: One pinned PR, comprehensive risk-weighted coverage, code and differential security, one returned ledger; receive-review or repair only when separately requested
Risk-focused preflight for AI-authored pull requests; normal multi-axis review remains 1-code-review
Audit tautological, echo, mock-only and zero-signal unit tests; rewrite to behavioral tests behind a mutation check
hardening shared with both sub-hubs; 2-software-architect is a bounded read-only system review with Architecture domain entry and catalog depth under 1-code-review
Mid-build verify, over-engineering, and thermo-nuclear maintainability cousins

One private draft/create/update reviewer-orientation artifact for one exact substantial PR, branch, commit, or diff candidate; no correctness verdict, implicit publication, browser launch, feedback loop, or code/Git effect
Adversarial decision review plus narrow read-only failure-behavior and Go-language reviews; both specialists are Architecture-primary and return findings to this caller
Superpowers harvest: process incoming review feedback

pipeline: honor requested mode; F-R1 only if ambiguous
pin caller, scope, comparison and actual candidate
sub-hub or skill → read-only evidence → return to caller
comprehensive PR review → 1-complete-pr-review → same-candidate code and differential-security passes plus risk-triggered coverage → one returned ledger
unfamiliar/whole-repo request → 1-codebase-review-strategy returns one coverage plan → separately authorized specialist review on the same candidate
standalone review stops at report; remediation, publication and integration require corresponding authority

forks.question: (inside 1-code-review) axes applicable?
branches: every applicable axis; missing spec/standards uses labeled baseline, not a false pass
